scheme_name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Pre-Series A Funding
other_conditions: The applicant must be an individual or a group with an innovative idea or concept, and must be recommended by an approved Nodal Institution.
The startup can belong to any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc.; the scheme is sector‑agnostic.
Startups that are already receiving benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.
benefits_summary: Provides mid‑level Pre‑Series A funding to bridge the financing gap during the ‘valley of death’ phase for startups.
